Title: Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program
Eligibility: Household income at or below 150% FPL
DocumentsRequired: Proof of income; Utility bill; ID; Household size verification

Title: Senior Citizen Rate Discount
Eligibility: Age 65+ and income at or below 200% FPL
DocumentsRequired: Proof of age; Proof of income; Utility account number

Title: COVID-19 Arrearage Forgiveness Program
Eligibility: Past-due balance accrued during March 2020 - December 2023

Title: Extended Payment Arrangement
Eligibility: Any customer with past-due balance over $100
